text: Case C twenty-nine. The Appointment Recovery Desk.
The brief: help a salon, or a tutoring centre, fill the slots that are genuinely open, and cut missed sessions, without ever overbooking.
Here's how it goes today. A client cancels, an hour before. The chair goes empty, and the money walks out the door.
Someone on the waitlist would have taken it. But who fits the slot? Who agreed to be messaged? Who gets there first?
So the front desk starts calling. Two people say yes. One slot. Now you've overbooked.
Meet Refill.
When a client cancels, Refill offers the empty slot to the waiting clients who fit it, and who said yes to messages. The first to accept gets it. Exactly one.
At the front desk, the whole day is a dial. One ring for each stylist, one arc for each appointment.
Harsh cancels his twelve o'clock. The gap opens, and starts to glow.
Refill shows who fits, and who is skipped, with a reason for every skip. No consent. Wrong skill. Not enough time.
One tap sends the offers. And before a single message goes out, the database checks every rule again.
On the client's phone, the offer arrives. One tap, and the slot is theirs.
Change your mind about messages? One STOP link pulls back every open offer, instantly.
Now, what if two phones tap at the very same moment?
One booking. The other client keeps their place on the waitlist. Never two people in one chair.
Staff see only their own day. And if someone can't come in, their gaps are held, their clients are flagged, and nothing moves until a person decides.
The owner sees the outcome. What was cancelled, what was recovered, and what's still open.
And the owner sets the rules. How long an offer holds. How often anyone can be messaged.

Offers hold for fifteen minutes, then move to the next in line. Nobody gets more than three a day. Late cancellations are flagged. Mistakes can be undone. And every step lands in an evidence log you can export.
Here's what makes Refill different. The rules don't just live in the app. They live in the database.
A sixty-minute service can never take a thirty-minute slot. Consent is checked at outreach, and again at booking. One slot, one booking. Guaranteed by the data itself.
Don't take our word for it. The Lab runs every case check live, against the real database.
The model is simple. One subscription per location. Next, a thirty-day pilot on one real calendar, measuring filled cancellations, no-shows, and staff effort.
Everything you've seen runs on synthetic data. The pilot is how we earn the real numbers.
Refill. Every cancelled appointment, filled again.
